text.offer: Problems? Yes, I've got a few right now. A bunch of rodents have been running around the cellar lately. I'd be in your debt if you dealt with them for me. Start with the small rats: twenty of them should do.
text.progress: Those rats won't clear themselves out of my cellar.
text.complete: Finally! Good job getting rid of those rodents. Have a drink on the house, and take this for your trouble.

steps.brief: Got the little ones? Good, but I've seen bigger ones down there as well. Go and kill fifteen of the rat soldiers for me.
Still alive, eh? Those rats have to be coming from somewhere. Find their leader and take him out: that'll put a stop to them.
